entities.title: Current event catalog
entities.definition: Maintain a source-grounded, deduplicated and lifecycle-aware catalog of eligible current and future events for all public consumers.

confidence.basis: Static build, data progression, acceptance and incident contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Critical data progression gate and public root release remain incomplete; recent lifecycle replay caused stale publication.

entities.title: Time- and context-based listing discovery
entities.definition: Present current events through Home, date, weekend, popular, unusual and related listing contexts with stable card and navigation semantics.

confidence.basis: Production routes, corrected archetypes and acceptance inventory.

unresolved_conflicts: Design-system families and archetypes remain reconstructed candidates rather than promoted UI resources.

entities.title: Curated collections, festivals, exhibitions and clubs
entities.definition: Expose editorial or domain-specific current event groupings with explicit criteria, source-grounded membership and safe fallback when supply is insufficient.

confidence.basis: Routes and data contracts exist but quality/promotion levels differ by family.

unresolved_conflicts: Several semantic collection labels remain blocked pending owner gold and quality evidence.

entities.title: Related and broader continuation
entities.definition: Continue discovery from an event through source-grounded related candidates and a finite diverse broader section without duplicates, unsafe family merges or infinite scroll.

confidence.basis: Related/vector barrier and continuation acceptance scenarios.

unresolved_conflicts: Related projections are optional and must retain compatible last-good or honest absence when vector evidence is stale.

entities.title: Event detail and decision support
entities.definition: Render one coherent current event identity with admitted media, summary, practical facts, occurrences, participants, venue, transport, intent actions and continuation.

confidence.basis: Accepted event-page family, corrected UI archetype and acceptance matrix.

unresolved_conflicts: Public root promotion is NO-GO and corrected UI SoT retains unresolved desktop/mobile states.

entities.title: Bounded intent Search
entities.definition: Resolve an eligible natural-language intent through one idempotent vector Search request, structural progress, exact large cards, typed terminal states and match feedback.

confidence.basis: Current Search contract and accepted live browser/Android/iOS evidence.

unresolved_conflicts: Runtime health proves the transport and UI journey, not a target satisfaction rate across all queries.

entities.title: Contextual and personalized discovery
entities.definition: Produce a safe non-empty static/contextual/personalized feed from accepted signals, compatible profile/model revisions and diversity rules, with explicit reset and fallback behavior.

confidence.basis: Detailed target architecture and acceptance exist; causal and complete production evidence do not.

unresolved_conflicts: No accepted randomized uplift; production mode and profile maturity coverage remain incomplete.

entities.title: Saved events and Favorites
entities.definition: Store, deduplicate, reconcile and present saved event identities across local and accepted account contexts with lifecycle-aware remove and undo behavior.

confidence.basis: Strong acceptance and UI contracts with incomplete end-to-end evidence.

unresolved_conflicts: Anonymous-to-account merge, account switching and multi-device lag need accepted runtime evidence.

entities.title: Event intent actions
entities.definition: Offer and safely execute save, calendar, share, ticket, registration, route and transport actions bound to the exact current event occurrence.

confidence.basis: Action taxonomy, UI surfaces and acceptance inventory.

unresolved_conflicts: Terminal evidence differs between internal commands and external navigation-only actions.

entities.title: Identity, session and account isolation
entities.definition: Support optional Yandex/email identity, session recovery, account switching and local/account state boundaries without making core public discovery depend on login.

confidence.basis: Identity acceptance and Search health session contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Identity UI ownership and state synchronization are not normalized across every archetype.

entities.title: Degraded mode and recovery
entities.definition: Classify failures, preserve safe static/last-good behavior, prevent false success and offer retry, alternate discovery or operator recovery.

confidence.basis: Release, Search, analytics and acceptance recovery contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Route × device × auth × network × data-state recovery coverage is incomplete.

entities.title: Media and critical-fact coherence
entities.definition: Keep admitted media, title, occurrence, venue, admission, lifecycle and outbound metadata coherent across cards, detail, JSON-LD, ICS, share and messages.

confidence.basis: Media/fact acceptance and production incident evidence.

unresolved_conflicts: Runtime incidents and unresolved UI states prevent a global healthy claim.

entities.title: Structured feedback and focus research
entities.definition: Collect bounded page/service/event feedback with identity, privacy, delivery and triage evidence while keeping usefulness, improvement, issue and NPS semantics distinct.

confidence.basis: Routes, prototypes, analytics and acceptance exist; production maturity differs by mode.

unresolved_conflicts: Focus-group prototype semantics and general production feedback must not be silently merged.

entities.title: Traceable product evidence and decision records
entities.definition: Maintain versioned questions, evidence, findings, decisions and follow-up links without reading raw production data into Product Atlas or converting hotspots into automatic findings.

confidence.basis: Product methodology, analysis and action-map contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Many measurement questions still have partial or missing terminal evidence.

entities.title: Immutable checked static release and rollback
entities.definition: Build from exact source/snapshot inputs, verify complete artifacts, publish immutable candidates, reject failed candidates and retain a known last-good rollback target.

confidence.basis: Release plan, candidate receipts and acceptance inventory.

unresolved_conflicts: Immutable secret candidate is proven, but live root buckets/ALB/SWS/DNS promotion and rollback remain blocked.

entities.title: Runtime health, incident and cost observability
entities.definition: Observe accepted service health, critical data progression, failures, queue state, release identity and budgets with typed evidence and incident closure.

confidence.basis: Search health, analytics, release and incident contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Search health is accepted; unified product analytics and critical data progression remain incomplete, and a recent disk incident occurred.
